title: First public preview
summary: A first public preview of Kota for macOS on Apple Silicon.
highlights: One room for each project, with up to 8 sitting agents from different providers, shared context, and a shared timeline.
Pure PTY, no SDK. Use your subscriptions safely.
Agent-to-agent communication and cross-project agent discussion, with humans in the loop.
Remote 24/7 access to all projects and all agents via Telegram, with a free Cloudflare Worker included.
Parallel worktrees for multitasking freely, with auto-sync and automatic conflict resolution.
A centralized skill pool, tiered rule management, an embedded Excalidraw board, timed tasks, and more waiting for you to explore.
